clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit Prabowo Refuses To Attend Police Ethics Hearing
aiSummaryBullets: Former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo refused to attend a scheduled ethics committee hearing.
The hearing, concerning alleged illegal wiretapping of the President, has been postponed until November 30, 2026.

clusters.headline: RSPAD Submits Health Test Results Of Andi Amran And Sugiono To MPR
aiSummaryBullets: RSPAD Gatot Soebroto completed 14 medical examination stages for vice presidential candidates Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono.
The candidates reported that the health screening process concluded without any physical complaints or complications.

clusters.headline: Prabowo and Polri Dismantle International Drug Trafficking Rings
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto and Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto destroyed over 601 tons of seized narcotics in Jakarta.
The National Police reported uncovering 56,203 drug-related cases over the past year, resulting in the arrest of 812 drug kingpins.

clusters.headline: Thirteen Dead and Thirteen Missing at Illegal Gold Mine in Bogor
aiSummaryBullets: Search and rescue teams have recovered 13 bodies from an illegal gold mining site located in the Ciguha area of Pongkor, Nanggung, Bogor.
Authorities confirm that 13 additional miners remain trapped or missing, while rescue efforts persist despite facing significant operational challenges.

clusters.headline: NasDem and PAN Support Sugiono for Vice President Nomination
aiSummaryBullets: Parties including NasDem and PAN have officially declared their support for Sugiono as the candidate for vice president.
The Gerindra party is actively coordinating with various parliamentary factions to secure broad support for the nomination.

clusters.headline: MPR Verification Team Confirms Eligibility Of Vice President Candidates
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR verification team confirmed that the population documents for vice presidential candidates Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono meet all requirements.
Verification officials validated a name change for Andi Amran Sulaiman based on a 2022 court ruling following discrepancies in his high school diploma.

clusters.headline: Kupang Regent Yosef Lede Named Suspect In Alleged Rape Case
aiSummaryBullets: Polda NTT has formally declared Kupang Regent Yosef Lede a suspect in the sexual assault case involving a 21-year-old university student.
The regent has been placed in police detention and faces potential charges carrying a maximum sentence of 12 years in prison.

clusters.headline: Persib Bandung Beats FC Seoul 3-1 To Secure AFC Champions League 2
aiSummaryBullets: Persib Bandung defeated FC Seoul 3-1 at Gelora Bandung Lautan Api Stadium.
The victory confirmed Persib Bandung as the winner of Group E in the AFC Champions League Two.

clusters.headline: Former MPR Secretary General Ma'ruf Cahyono Faces Corruption Trial
aiSummaryBullets: Ma'ruf Cahyono, the former Secretary General of the People's Consultative Assembly, has been charged with accepting 30.91 billion rupiah in gratifications.
The prosecution alleges the funds were illicitly obtained in connection with various procurement projects conducted within the MPR Secretariat.

clusters.headline: Expansion of Kopdes Merah Putih and Kampung Nelayan Initiatives
aiSummaryBullets: State electricity firm PLN plans to collaborate with Kopdes Merah Putih on a 100 gigawatt solar power project.
The government is scaling up the Kampung Nelayan Merah Putih program with new locations in East Kalimantan and Donggala.

clusters.headline: House Commission X Urges CPNS Certainty For Teachers Over Age 35
aiSummaryBullets: House Commission X is demanding clarity on technical guidelines for teacher recruitment for candidates exceeding the 35-year age limit.
Regional governments, including Majalengka and East Kalimantan, are transitioning part-time PPPK teachers to full-time status starting in 2027.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Expands Sekolah Rakyat Program To Combat National Poverty
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo aims to establish 500 Sekolah Rakyat units as a strategic effort to break the cycle of poverty through education.
The Ministry of Social Affairs and the Ministry of Development and Creative Economy have signed an MoU to integrate adolescent counseling into the program.

clusters.headline: OECD Forecasts Indonesia's Economic Outlook And Potential Risks
aiSummaryBullets: The OECD projects Indonesia's economic growth to reach 5.4 percent in 2026, an increase from 5.1 percent in 2025.
International experts warn of potential extreme risks that could trap the national economy in a period of low growth beyond 2026.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Confirm Listyo Sigit Cannot Resign Amid Treason Case
aiSummaryBullets: Police officials state Listyo Sigit is ineligible to resign while facing criminal allegations and potential code of ethics violations.
Investigations are ongoing regarding claims of unauthorized wiretapping of the President and involvement in alleged treasonous activities.

clusters.headline: US Weighs Targeting Iranian Leaders Amid Ongoing Regional Conflict
aiSummaryBullets: The Trump administration is debating whether to target senior Iranian leaders in an effort to end the ongoing regional conflict.
Iranian officials deny developing chemical weapons, alleging that Israel is attempting to manipulate the US into further military engagement.

clusters.headline: DVI Teams Identify Remains Following Massive Fire At PT FAM Cikande
aiSummaryBullets: Police forensic teams are accelerating DNA testing to identify remains recovered from the site of the factory fire.
Search efforts for dozens of missing individuals have been hindered by unstable building structures and adverse weather conditions.

clusters.headline: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Reports Drug Trafficking Trends To President
aiSummaryBullets: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto met with President Prabowo Subianto to discuss current narcotics distribution patterns.
The police chief highlighted new methods used to target young people, specifically noting the use of vaping products and laughing gas.

clusters.headline: Government Agencies Prepare For Natal And Tahun Baru 2026-2027
aiSummaryBullets: Government agencies are conducting food security inspections and price monitoring to stabilize supplies ahead of the holiday period.
Transportation authorities and police are inspecting public bus safety and railway infrastructure to ensure passenger readiness.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Continues Pushing For ASEAN Regional Cooperation
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto continues his diplomatic strategy focusing on deeper regional integration and economic partnerships.
MIND ID is actively seeking to enhance mineral industry integration between Indonesia and Malaysia to increase regional value.

clusters.headline: Harga Emas Antam Naik Rp2.000 Pada 24 November Jadi Rp2,507 Juta
aiSummaryBullets: Harga emas batangan Antam mencatat kenaikan tipis sebesar Rp2.000 pada perdagangan Selasa, 24 November 2026.
Nilai per gram emas Antam kini berada di angka Rp2,507 juta.
